title: To what extent are the 2000 and 2003 RTP graphics interchangeable?

posts.author: TMS
posts.body: I recently bought both RPG Maker 2000 and 2003, and I was wondering if it would be possible to use graphical elements from the former's RTP in the latter if I wanted to (characters, tilesets, facesets, battle backgrounds, etc.). Are the two games' resources pretty much interchangeable (apart from 2000's lack of side-view battlers)? Are some types of graphic interchangeable while others are not? Or are they just completely incompatible? Please let me know.

posts.author: Litningman06
posts.body:
They are 100% compatible with one another (apart from the sideview battlers) Both makers use the same formatting for their graphics, so you could take a charset of chipset from 2000 and use it in 2003 no problem. The only thing is if you want to use the RTP from one in another, you need to own the maker that that RTP is originally for. So in your case, you need to own both 2000 and 2003. Hope this helps!
EDIT: Also to note is that the RTPs for these makers also share a lot of graphics too, mostly tilesets, so make sure you don’t end up with duplicates making your file size needlessly bigger.

posts.author: TMS
posts.body: That answers my question perfectly. Thank you!
